title: Mark's Bay Cottages & Campground

services.name: Cottage Rentals
services.desc: Our cottages are a home away from home and are available year round, rented on a monthly basis.Cottages are a favourite for out of town workers looking for a place to stay beyond a cramped hotel room. Our cottages include an open kitchen, dining, and living room area; a bathroom, and bedroom with a double bed on the main floor.On the upper floor is a second bedroom, divided in two by the stairwell and is usually configured with two twin beds on one end, and a double bed at the other end.Each cottage can accommodate a family of 6.
